critical_code_review_comments: WorkGallery: preload='none' + play() on hover works but first hover may have slight delay while metadata loads; consider preload='metadata' for snappier UX.
Videos have no accessible label/aria-label; consider adding aria-label to each gallery tile for a11y.
About image has grayscale filter that only reverts on hover of the image itself; fine, but on touch devices users won't see color.
